primary_goal: 在 SSD/NVMe/HBF 共享 NAND 模型边界内，检查 background/GC/FTL marker、queue 冲突、die/channel unknown 和 erase/program 状态是否显式传播，不引入未经来源核验的硬件数值。
method: prepare -> verify -> predict -> score -> review -> promote

baseline.role: H47 reproducibility toolchain fix; H40 shared NAND erase path as background, not reopened wholesale

previous_direction: 开发工具链与可复现性（H47）
direction_switch_reason: H47 工具链 provenance 修复完成；按用户定向存储任务和台账轮换回 NAND 家族，收口 H40 明确延期的 background/FTL/GC/die/channel unknown 与 queue 边界，不重开 H39 DRAM/HBM 或 H40 erase 主链路。
recent_directions: H46:运行速度与内存（有限负结论）
H47:开发工具链与可复现性（已接纳）
H48:存储硬件建模粒度（活动）

scope.candidate: shared NAND family background marker, queue conflict, erase/program state, die/channel/FTL/GC unknown provenance across hbf_media/data_motion/PhysicalService/endpoint/report

problem_domain_closure.rule: 同一 NAND background/unknown queue 根因若影响 media state、DataAccess/PhysicalService、endpoint/legacy alias、report 或 error handling，必须同轮收口；未知参数必须显式保留。

data_roles.development: fresh NAND source scan and state/queue controls
data_roles.holdout: independent SSD/NVMe/HBF alias and unsupported/unknown controls
data_roles.final_acceptance: storage mechanism/provenance only; no Native accuracy

guardrails: 不重开 H40 erase 主链路
不导入未经来源核验的 die/channel/GC 数值
unknown/fallback 必须显式，不得当作零成本
无真实 NAND 执行缺陷不改源码
next_step: 先独立扫描 hbf_media.py、data_motion.py、PhysicalService、endpoint/legacy alias 和 reporting 的 background/queue/unknown 传播，登记唯一可证伪候选或有限负结论。
